excerpts.text:
Sep 24, 2025

Into a Sun-soaked sky above the Florida coast, [NASA’s Interstellar Mapping and Acceleration Probe](https://science.nasa.gov/mission/imap/) (IMAP) was launched aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket from the agency’s Kennedy Space Center at 7:30 a.m.

At approximately 8:57 a.m. EDT, flight controllers at the Johns Hopkins Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) in Laurel, Maryland, confirmed the IMAP spacecraft was operating normally and ready to begin its journey to Lagrange Point 1 (L1), approximately 1 million miles (about 1.6 million kilometers) from Earth toward the Sun.
